-        prev = idx
-        app((chr(p0) + chr(p1), chr(idx)))

+        prev = idx
+        a = chr(p0)
+        b = chr(p1)
+        app((a + b, a, b, chr(idx)))
+    return table
+
+
+def _apply_table(s, table):
+    """
+    s.replace(ps, c) for every (ps, a, b, c) entry of table in order, where
+    ps == a + b. Exact per-character counts of s are kept up to date (each
+    replacement removes one a and one b and adds one c), so a replacement is
+    skipped, without scanning s, when a or b does not occur in s: it could
+    not match anything. Same result as doing every replacement.
+    """
+    cnt = {}
+    _count_elements(cnt, s)
+    get = cnt.get
+    for ps, a, b, c in table:
+        na = get(a)
+        if not na or not get(b):
+            continue
+        t = s.replace(ps, c)
+        m = len(s) - len(t)
+        if m:
+            cnt[a] = na - m
+            cnt[b] = get(b) - m
+            cnt[c] = get(c, 0) + m
+            s = t
+    return s
